column1: # OSBundleRequired per graphics kext (nextbsd-kernel-extensions#4), by role, as Mac OS X 10.9.5 tags its own:
#   Safe Boot  the drivers that light up the display and the libraries they load with
#   (no key)   3D-only accelerators (10.9: AppleIntelHD4000Graphics, AMDRadeonX4000, GeForce): V3D here
# A tagged kext's libraries are tagged too: in Safe Mode only tagged kexts load.
# A trailing "?" marks a kext only one arch builds. tools/set-osbundlerequired.py applies this table;
# nothing reads the key yet (it is for a pre-root load path).
